name: Will
source:
Lives in Plen Arc. She is a member of "Song of God" and tasked with the duty of conveying the will of God to people through dance.

God called to her, but because she defied him, the oracles have decimated Plen Arc.
When ALES arrives in Plen Arc, she has gone missing.
The question is whether she perished with the city, or...

[Taken from Hirameki International]
